description: What delete_keyword would remove or change, changing nothing: the keyword's mentions (matches), what it cost this month (charges already made stay, deleting refunds nothing), and every alert rule, automation and view whose filter names it, each with its effect: disabled (it named only this keyword and is switched off), narrowed (it stops naming it and keeps working) or empty (a view naming only it then shows nothing). Call it before delete_keyword and tell the person.
